feelings.intro: 請幼兒選擇最符合感受的表情：😭 = 好唔開心；🙁 = 唔開心；😐 = 唔清楚／唔肯定；🙂 = 開心；😀 = 好開心
feelings.q1a: Q1a. 你嚟到童亮館嗰陣覺得點呀？
q1bOptions: 係乜嘢令到你開心/唔開心？（根據幼兒上一題的回答提問）
feelings.q2a: Q2a. 你鍾唔鍾意喺童亮館同同學仔一齊玩？
feelings.q2b: Q2b. 跟進問題（請按次序提問以下兩條問題）
q2bOptions: 同朋友喺呢度玩嘅時候，邊樣嘢最好玩？
你仲想喺呢度同朋友玩啲咩新遊戲？
feelings.q3a: Q3a. 你鍾唔鍾意童亮館入面啲玩具同設施？
feelings.q3b: Q3b. 跟進問題（請按次序提問以下兩條問題）
q3bOptions: 點解你鐘意/唔鍾意玩嗰個玩具/設施？
你希望童亮館有啲咩玩？
feelings.q4a: Q4a. 你鍾唔鍾意參加童亮館嘅活動？
feelings.q4b: Q4b. 跟進問題（請按次序提問以下兩條問題）
q4bOptions: 點解你鐘意/唔鍾意嗰啲活動？
你覺得最好玩嘅活動係咩？
feelings.q5a: Q5a. 童亮館令你覺得安全嗎？
q5bOptions: （若幼兒回答不安全）點解令你覺得唔安全？
（若幼兒回答安全）有冇啲乜嘢令你感到安全？
feelings.q6a: Q6a. 童亮館嘅姑娘/老師有冇喺你需要幫手嘅時候幫你？
feelings.q6b: Q6b. 跟進問題（請按次序提問以下兩條問題）
q6bOptions: （若幼兒回答係否定）係發生乜嘢事？/你嗰陣需要乜嘢幫助？
（若幼兒回答係肯定）佢哋係點樣幫助你架？

memory.q7: Q7. 你記唔記得自己K2嚟過童亮館幾多次？
memory.q8: Q8. 你記得自己喺度做過啲咩？（如有任何觀察請記錄）

closing.intro: 請向幼兒提問以下全部問題，幼兒可以講出嚟或者畫出嚟
closing.q1: 你仲想唔想再嚟童亮館？
closing.q4: 如果可以改一樣童亮館入面嘅嘢，你會改邊樣？
closing.q5: 仲有冇啲乜嘢想同我哋分享？

adminFields.requiredFieldsWarning: Please complete all required fields marked *

feelings.intro: For each question, present a horizontal row of FIVE smiley faces:   😭 = Very unhappy   🙁 = Not happy   😐 = Not sure   🙂 = Happy   😀 = Very happy
feelings.q1a: Q1a. How did you feel when you came to the hub?
q1bOptions: What made you happy or sad?
feelings.q2a: Q2a. Did you like playing with your classmates at the hub?
q2bOptions: What was the most fun thing you played with your friends?
What new game would you like to play with your friends here?
feelings.q3a: Q3a. Did you like the toys or materials in the hub?
q3bOptions: Why did you like or dislike that toy or material to play with?
What toy do you wish we had at the hub?
feelings.q4a: Q4a. Did you like the activities you did at the hub?
q4bOptions: Why did you like or dislike those activities?
What was the most fun thing you did?
feelings.q5a: Q5a. Did you feel safe at the hub?
q5bOptions: If no, why did you not feel safe?
If yes, what made you feel safe?
feelings.q6a: Q6a. Did hub staff help you when you needed something?
q6bOptions: If no, what happened / did you need?
If yes, how did they help you?

memory.q7: Q7. Do you remember how many times you have come to play at the hub?
memory.q8: Q8. What do you remember doing? (please also note any observations)

images.configIncomplete: Class configuration incomplete. Image questions not available.
images.aiNote: Note: Some of the images used in this questionnaire were generated by AI for research purposes.
images.batch1Question: Q{index}.1a. Do you remember which of the following scenes you played in at hub?
batch1FollowUpOptions: Can you remember what you did here? (tell us)
images.batch2Question: Q{index}.2a. Do you remember who you played with at this session?
batch2FollowUpOptions: Do you remember what you did together? (tell us)
How did that make you feel?
images.batch3Question: Q{index}.3a. Do you remember where did you play at this session?
images.batch4Question: Q{index}.4a. Do you remember which of the following scenes you played in at hub?
batch4FollowUpOptions: Do you remember what you did here? (tell us)

closing.intro: Please ask the child the following questions (child may answer verbally or draw)
closing.q1: Would you like to come back to the hub again?
closing.q2: Why do you want / not want to come back? (Draw or tell us)
closing.q3: What do you want to do next time? (Draw or tell us)
closing.q4: If you could change one thing about our hub, what would it be? (Draw or say)
closing.q5: Is there anything else you would like to share? (Draw or tell us)
